explanation.bottleneck: The reference constructs encoded priority results, decodes them into one-hot grants, and computes the next round-robin mask through index arithmetic and variable shifts. This creates potentially deep reconvergent feedback logic. The supplied mapped paths confirm substantial combinational depth and buffering, but do not identify an exact RTL cone.
explanation.area_or_other_cost: Parallel overlapping reductions can increase wiring, fanout, or duplicated logic, although synthesis may share their terms. Removing the variable-shift mask logic may offset that cost. Mapped area must be checked against the fixed 4880.43072 um2 cap; neither area compliance nor timing improvement is measured.
explanation.rewrite: Replace the two helper instances with top-local parallel priority reductions that directly produce one-hot winners. Select the masked winner when available, otherwise select the unrestricted winner. Compute grant_encoded with OR reductions and compute the next round-robin mask directly from winner prefixes or suffixes, eliminating the encoded-index-to-variable-shift mask computation. Keep blocking and synchronous reset behavior unchanged.
explanation.expected_timing_gain: The intended improvement is a shorter mask/grant feedback path by removing encode/decode and arithmetic/shift stages. No candidate synthesis, equivalence check, or STA has been run here, so improvement over the measured baseline WNS of 7.80 ns is not established.
explanation.functional_boundaries: Preserves the top interface, parameter names/defaults, register initialization values, single positive-edge clock, active-high synchronous reset, and output latency. Arbitrary multi-bit request and acknowledge inputs are handled without one-hot assumptions. The one-hot property used for encoding is produced internally by priority selection. During a blocked grant all output registers and the mask retain their previous values; without requests, outputs clear and the mask holds. Reset remains effective on every edge where rst is high. The frozen helper module is neither modified nor redefined. Formal equivalence against the original frozen RTL under the specified startup contract and parameter overrides remains required.
output_format_normalization: Removed complete leading think wrapper before JSON parsing
